formula: sum passive F size at attacked L0:L2 / max(initial displayed size at attacked L0:L2,1)
mechanism: aggressive consumption of known initial liquidity
causal_cutoff_rule: only completed F_LAST packets strictly before exclusive cutoff
expected_A_vs_B: high A can absorb large consumption; B alone is not determined

formula: sum pure-C size at attacked L0:L2 / max(initial displayed size at attacked L0:L2,1)
mechanism: liquidity withdrawal distinct from fill-driven depletion
causal_cutoff_rule: exclude ambiguous F/C groups and incomplete packets

window: removal through 250ms; survival observed at min(t_burst+500ms,t_cutoff)
formula: refill size added within 100ms after removal and still live at observation / max(fill size + pure-C size removed,1)
mechanism: durable replenishment rather than transient flashing
causal_cutoff_rule: refill and survival observations must both precede cutoff

formula: remaining size of orders present at t_burst in attacked L0:L2 / max(their size at t_burst,1)
mechanism: survival of pre-existing queue under aggression
causal_cutoff_rule: state reconstructed only from ordered completed packets

formula: positive directional best-passive price progress in ticks / max(aggressor T size / max(initial attacked depth,1),epsilon)
mechanism: price movement produced per normalized aggressive volume
causal_cutoff_rule: price and T observations strictly before cutoff; finite cap frozen in training fold only
expected_A_vs_B: lower in A and higher in B

formula: nanoseconds original L0 has zero displayed size / observed nanoseconds in window
mechanism: persistence rather than instantaneous touch depletion
causal_cutoff_rule: integrate state only between completed packets before cutoff
expected_A_vs_B: lower in A and higher in B

formula: aggression packets followed within 100ms by durable refill and no >=1 tick directional best-passive advance within next 100ms / max(aggression packets,1)
causal_cutoff_rule: all three motif elements must complete before cutoff

formula: removal packets followed within 100ms by original-L0 depletion lasting >=50ms and >=1 tick directional best-passive advance without durable refill / max(removal packets,1)
causal_cutoff_rule: all motif elements must complete before cutoff
